items.text: When there is alternating curentin a coil,themagneticfield arounditis continuously changing.As the size of the current in the coilincreases the field grows.As the size of the current decreases thefield collapses.lf a second coil isplaced nearthefirst,this growing and collapsing magneticfieldwillpass throughit.Asit cuts through the wires of the second coil,avoltage isinduced across that coil.The size and direction of the inducedvoltage changes as thevoltage applied to the first coil changes.(The first coil ismore usually called theprimary coil.)An alternatingvoltageapplied across theprimary coil therefore produces an altermatingvoltage across the secondary coil.This combination oftwomagneticallylinked coilsiscalledatransformer.
